import sys
from collections import deque

INF = 0x7f7f7f7f

def add_edge(u, v, cap, cst):
    global edge_pointer, head, next_edge, to_node, capacity, cost_edge
    edge_pointer += 1
    next_edge[edge_pointer] = head[u]
    to_node[edge_pointer] = v
    capacity[edge_pointer] = cap
    cost_edge[edge_pointer] = cst
    head[u] = edge_pointer

def spfa_algorithm():
    global dist, in_queue, parent, last_edge, flow
    for i in range(len(dist)):
        dist[i] = INF
    for i in range(len(in_queue)):
        in_queue[i] = False
    q = deque()
    q.append(s)
    in_queue[s] = True
    dist[s] = 0
    flow[s] = sys.maxsize
    parent[t] = -1
    while q:
        u = q.popleft()
        in_queue[u] = False
        i = head[u]
        while i != 0:
            if capacity[i] and dist[to_node[i]] > dist[u] + cost_edge[i]:
                dist[to_node[i]] = dist[u] + cost_edge[i]
                parent[to_node[i]] = u
                last_edge[to_node[i]] = i
                flow[to_node[i]] = min(flow[u], capacity[i])
                if not in_queue[to_node[i]]:
                    in_queue[to_node[i]] = True
                    q.append(to_node[i])
            i = next_edge[i]
    return parent[t] != -1

def compute_mcmf():
    global flow_total, cost_total
    flow_total = 0
    cost_total = 0
    while spfa_algorithm():
        current_node = t
        flow_total += flow[t]
        cost_total += flow[t] * dist[t]
        while current_node != s:
            capacity[last_edge[current_node]] -= flow[t]
            capacity[last_edge[current_node] ^ 1] += flow[t]
            current_node = parent[current_node]

def node_id(layer, node):
    return layer * n + node

# Read input
input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
n, m, p, c, d = map(int, input_data[0:5])
index = 5
s = 0
t = n * 99 + 1

# Initialize arrays
max_nodes = 5000005
max_edges = 10000010
head = [0] * (max_nodes)
next_edge = [0] * (max_edges)
to_node = [0] * (max_edges)
capacity = [0] * (max_edges)
cost_edge = [0] * (max_edges)
dist = [0] * (max_nodes)
parent = [0] * (max_nodes)
last_edge = [0] * (max_nodes)
flow = [0] * (max_nodes)
in_queue = [False] * (max_nodes)

edge_pointer = 1

# Read p nodes
p_nodes = list(map(int, input_data[index:index+p]))
index += p

# Read edges
x = [0] * (m+1)
y = [0] * (m+1)
for i in range(1, m+1):
    x[i], y[i] = map(int, input_data[index:index+2])
    index += 2

# Build graph
for i in range(1, p+1):
    add_edge(s, node_id(0, p_nodes[i-1]), 1, 0)
    add_edge(node_id(0, p_nodes[i-1]), s, 0, 0)

for i in range(0, 100):
    add_edge(node_id(i, 1), node_id(i+1, 1), INF, 0)
    add_edge(node_id(i+1, 1), node_id(i, 1), 0, 0)
    for j in range(2, n+1):
        add_edge(node_id(i, j), node_id(i+1, j), INF, c)
        add_edge(node_id(i+1, j), node_id(i, j), 0, -c)
    for j in range(1, m+1):
        for k in range(1, p+1):
            cst = d * k * k - d * (k - 1) * (k - 1) + c
            add_edge(node_id(i, x[j]), node_id(i+1, y[j]), 1, cst)
            add_edge(node_id(i+1, y[j]), node_id(i, x[j]), 0, -cst)
            add_edge(node_id(i, y[j]), node_id(i+1, x[j]), 1, cst)
            add_edge(node_id(i+1, x[j]), node_id(i, y[j]), 0, -cst)

# Run min cost max flow
compute_mcmf()

# Output result
print(cost_total)
